summary: Diff implements a new frontend “Personal Records” signed-in experience with separate React Query keys and mutations, and introduces a second backend Map intended for personal records. However, the diff summary does not provide evidence that the backend actually exposes the required personal-record CRUD APIs scoped to caller identity, nor that admin APIs are restricted to the admin store only. No migration logic is shown. Some extra backend functionality (user profiles) appears added without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose dedicated personal-record CRUD APIs that are scoped to the caller Principal so users can only list/read/update/delete their own personal records; reject unauthorized callers with clear errors; and ensure Admin Panel APIs operate only on the admin record store.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows a new `personalRecords : Map<Principal, Data>` and `persons : Map<Text, Data>` split, but the diff excerpt does not include any `createPersonalRecord/readPersonalRecord/updatePersonalRecord/deletePersonalRecord` implementations, nor evidence that existing admin APIs were updated to only access `persons` (admin store) and never touch `personalRecords`.

missing_requirements.requirement: If schema changes would drop/orphan existing stored records, add a conditional Motoko migration to preserve existing data into the appropriate new store(s) and ensure upgrades do not trap.
missing_requirements.reason: No `backend/migration.mo` was added, and the diff summary provides no evidence of stable variable/upgrade handling (e.g., preupgrade/postupgrade) to preserve existing records when introducing the new separated stores.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend user profile types and APIs (UserProfile, userProfiles Map, getCallerUserProfile/getUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of the BuildRequest requirements (which focus on separating admin vs personal record storage and UI/hooks).
